newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain Commercial Facilities in $20mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain Commercial Facilities in $20mln loan.

text.p: Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company (BCFC) has signed a $20 million syndicated medium-term loan facility with banks.

The loan, signed on Monday, is arranged by The Arab Investment Company (TAIC) and Banque Paribas, a unit of Groupe Paribas, and was at a margin of 100 basis points over LIBOR, TAIC said in a statement.
The four-year loan would be used to finance activities of the company and customers services, an official at TAIC told Reuters on Tuesday.
BCFC, traded on the Bahrain Stock Exchange, is specialised in providing loans to individuals and firms. It posted a net profit of 0.42 million dinars in the first quarter of 1997.
